logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient (D) of the 99mTc complexes was determined according to the shake flask method. 20 μL of the HPLC-purified 99mTc complexes (100–150 μCi) were mixed with 2 mL of 1-octanol and 1.98 mL of phosphate-buffer solution (0.1 M, pH = 7.4) in a centrifuge tube. The mixtures were vortexed for 1 min at room temperature and centrifuged for 10 min at 3500 rpm. The radioactivity of aliquots (50 μL) of both the 1-octanol and PBS phase was counted in a γ-counter. The experiment was run in triplicate. The distribution coefficient (D7.4) was calculated by dividing the counts of the 1-octanol phase by those of the PBS phase, and the results were expressed as logD7.4 ± SD, where SD: Standard Deviation [50,51].
